title: Data-driven balanced truncation of K-power bilinear systems
summary: As a special type of bilinear systems, K-power bilinear systems possess a special coupled structure along with nice properties in practice. In this paper, we investigate the data-driven counterpart of balanced truncation for K-power systems. As the standard balanced truncation is performed based on the subsystems of K-power systems, the main idea is to approximate the quantities of each reduced subsystem with the evaluations of transfer functions.
